## RunOptions type

What `run` is asked: what holds for the process and what holds for this call, in one object  (README, "Running", gives each option with its default).

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type RunOptions<Ctx, Ps extends readonly ProviderRef[] = readonly string[], Rs extends readonly BaseRef[] = readonly BaseRef[]> = RunEnv & RunCall<Ctx, Ps, Rs>;
```
